decisions.evidence: Across all six neighbors, the most repeated and chemically convincing signal is the presence of an alkyl chloride in the query, often together with an alkene, and in one case with an additional alkyl bromide. The size, polarity, and surface-area differences vary from neighbor to neighbor, but they mostly describe exposure-related context rather than undermining the explicit structural alert. Because the query consistently retains the halogenated unsaturated motif associated with mutagenic behavior, the combined neighbor evidence supports option (B): is mutagenic.
